headline: Centralize cent rounding in shared MoneyMath.ToCents across Fx, Fees, Deposits, and Loans
summary: Introduces Bank.Shared.Money.MoneyMath.ToCents to round monetary amounts to two decimal places using midpoint away-from-zero. Replaces inline decimal.Round and Math.Round calls across DepositService, FeeCalculator, FxService, and LoanService at the same calculation steps.

T:Bank.Shared.Money.MoneyMath.changed: Added shared helper class providing centralized cent rounding for monetary amounts.

T:Bank.Modules.Deposits.Application.Depo.changed: Updated term deposit validation and interest calculation to use the shared cent-rounding helper.

module:Deposits.affected: 2 part(s) depend on the change and 5 part(s) are reached by it: Open, Mature, Id, CustomerId….

T:Bank.Modules.Fees.Application.FeeCalcu.changed: Updated FX fee quote calculation to round fee and bounds through MoneyMath.ToCents.

T:Bank.Modules.Fx.Application.FxService.changed: Updated currency conversion to round the converted result via MoneyMath.ToCents.
T:Bank.Modules.Fx.Application.FxService.affected: NormalizeAndValidate and FromEur are called inside FxService.Convert before rounding the result with MoneyMath.ToCents.
T:Bank.Modules.Fx.Application.FxService.affected_facts: 2 part(s) are reached by it: NormalizeAndValidate, FromEur.

module:Fx.affected: 2 part(s) are reached by it: NormalizeAndValidate, FromEur.

T:Bank.Modules.Loans.Application.LoanSer.changed: Updated loan principal validation and monthly annuity calculation to use MoneyMath.ToCents.

reasons.text: 2 changed method(s) have no usable test evidence
reasons.say: Changes in DepositService and FeeCalculator have no test evidence, risking wrong customer fees or deposit amounts. Ask for tests proving their outputs still match pre-change cent values.
reasons.say_facts: 2 changed parts of the code are not covered by any working test. Read them yourself or ask for tests.

reasons.text: Reviewer asks a human to check Where
reasons.detail: Tier HIGH → full human read and 2 sign-off(s) required
reasons.say: Because rounding affects customer balances, fees, and loans, this high-risk change requires a full human read. Verify all rounding steps remain unchanged and ensure two sign-offs are recorded.
reasons.say_facts: The change touches a sensitive part of the bank. Check that only the intended places changed.
